postal_system.full_code_format: seven alphanumeric characters, normally ANN ANNN; D6W is the only letter-number-letter Routing Key exception
postal_system.assignment_rule: A current Eircode assignment is a unique identifier for one postal address and its geographic location. The first three characters are the Routing Key and the final four are the Unique Identifier. Syntax, a Routing Key, an Eircode Finder marker, a coordinate, a NUTS match or a licensed database field alone does not authorize publication or prove a Polygon/MultiPolygon for the seven-character code.
postal_system.normalization_rule: Trim, uppercase and remove at most the separator between Routing Key and Unique Identifier, then display as three characters, one space and four characters. Preserve D6W and reject the letter O as an issued character; normalization does not prove assignment.
postal_system.full_code_geometry_rule: A seven-character Eircode identifies an address or property and is non-area unless an independent competent source explicitly supplies a truthful area. Never buffer, Voronoi-partition or dissolve its point into an Eircode polygon.
postal_system.routing_key_geometry_rule: A Routing Key identifies a principal post-town span. A routing-key surface may be served only from an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon release with all 139 keys, edition, effective date, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions, terms and SHA-256. It must be labelled as Routing Key context, not as the exact seven-character Eircode geometry.
postal_system.po_box_rule: Eircodes are not currently assigned to PO Box numbers. PO boxes and other routing endpoints remain non-area and never receive an invented polygon.
postal_system.address_rule: ECAF contains Eircode and postal-address identity; ECAD adds coordinates and other address-related fields. Both are licensed products. An address coordinate is not a building footprint, parcel, occupancy, ownership or postal perimeter.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building output requires an explicit rights-cleared source relation from the Eircode or address identifier to a building feature. ECAD availability, an Eircode Finder marker, point containment, proximity or shared text does not establish a redistributable building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: NUTS, counties, local authorities, local electoral areas and CSO statistical geography are separate context. Routing Key areas may cross county boundaries; no administrative unit may be relabelled as an Eircode or Routing Key perimeter.
postal_system.licence_rule: Every ECAF, ECAD, GeoDirectory, CSO, GISCO, TERCET or other artifact pins the exact access terms, provider, URL, capture/download time, edition, scope, CRS, reviewed transform, byte length and SHA-256. Public Finder access and evaluation samples do not establish bulk extraction, redistribution, derivative-database or public API rights.
postal_system.territory_rule: The IE pack covers Ireland only and does not merge Northern Ireland or any other identity. Postal Routing Keys do not determine sovereignty or silently import cross-border geometry.

integration.postcode_flow: normalized seven-character Eircode -> current licensed or rights-cleared assignment -> explicit non-area address identity -> separately labelled rights-cleared Routing Key Polygon/MultiPolygon when available -> address/building relation from a separate authority -> IE AGID cells
integration.coordinate_flow: Eircode address coordinate or honest unavailable result -> optional separately labelled Routing Key context area -> explicit address-to-building relation -> rights-cleared building -> IE AGID cell
integration.building_output_gate: current Eircode or address identity plus an explicit source-defined rights-cleared building identifier/relation and exact building geometry

quality_gates.pass: Every code remains text, normalizes to seven characters with the D6W exception preserved, and distinguishes syntax from current assignment.
The nationwide Eircode denominator pins current edition, effective date, update cadence, terms, coverage, exceptions, byte length and SHA-256.
Every seven-character address identifier remains point/non-area unless an independent competent source explicitly supplies area geometry; no buffer, Voronoi cell or proxy is created.
Every displayed routing-key area comes from a complete authoritative or rights-cleared real 139-key Polygon/MultiPolygon release and remains visibly separate from the exact Eircode.
ECAF/ECAD/GeoDirectory licences, Finder conditions, CSO confidentiality and GISCO/TERCET terms remain enforceable per artifact; access is never treated as redistribution authority.
Eircode assignment, Routing Key area, address, building, administration, occupancy and ownership remain distinct authorities and relations.
No resident, recipient, occupant, owner, rightsholder, personal contact, title/value, credential, shipment or delivery instruction is published.
Generic IE planning cells and synthetic fixtures verify behavior only and never satisfy production M2 evidence.

stages.definition: Country-specific contracts, authority separation and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current rights-cleared nationwide seven-character Eircode assignment denominator, preserving the D6W Routing Key exception and the fact that each full Eircode is an address/property identity rather than an area, and an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon release for all 139 Routing Keys are pinned by edition, validity, terms, CRS, SHA-256, coverage and exceptions and published as an approved immutable artifact. Searching a normalized full Eircode through the real IE API/app must return its honest point/non-area reason and, when available, the separately labelled official/derived/virtual Routing Key context surface, fit the map and render translucent fill plus a clear outline with selected code, geometry kind, source, reference date and confidence. Finder markers, ECAF/ECAD fields without publication rights, GISCO/TERCET point or NUTS correspondence, CSO statistical classifications, counties, buildings, parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells and synthetic planning fixtures never satisfy M2.
Complete rights-cleared address membership and coordinates pass derivation, topology, coverage, uncertainty and correction gates for explicitly derived Routing Key context only.
Licensed address identity and exact rights-cleared building relationships pass identifier, privacy, CRS, coverage and redistribution gates.
